original_reference: Kline, M. A., & Boyd, R. (2010). Population size predicts technological complexity in Oceania. Proceedings of the Royal Society B, 277(1693), 2559-2564.
description: Tool complexity in 10 Oceanic societies. Columns: culture, population, contact (low/high), total_tools, mean_TU (mean technological units). Used to illustrate Poisson regression and the relationship between population size and technological complexity.
